package.description: WebLogic Remote Console is a lightweight, open source console that you can use to manage your WebLogic Server domain running anywhere, such as on a physical or virtual machine, in a container, Kubernetes, or in the Oracle Cloud.

en-US.description: WebLogic Remote Console is a lightweight, open source console that you can use to manage your WebLogic Server domain running anywhere, such as on a physical or virtual machine, in a container, Kubernetes, or in the Oracle Cloud.
en-US.name: WebLogic Remote Console
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's New in WebLogic Remote Console 3.0.7
- Support for WebLogic Server 26.1.0.0.0! New features include:
  - Enhanced Certificate Management support
  - Support for Jakarta NoSQL system resource configuration
- Security feature gate enhancements:
  - New security feature gates
  - New security warnings for disabled feature gates
- Misc. updates to WebLogic Server MBeans and their attributes
Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where changing a property on an Oracle Apps Adapter outbound connection pool instance also changed the property on other pool instances.
- Fixed issue where individual user sessions for a web application were not displayed.
- Fixed issue that prevented users from starting or stopping Managed Servers whose names contain a period.
- Fixed issue where Hosted WebLogic Remote Console offered the unsupported Use Web Authentication option when creating or editing an Administration Server provider.
- Fixed issue where validation errors were not displayed when committing changes directly from the shopping cart.
- Improved scrolling behavior when WebLogic Remote Console is magnified.
Known Issues
- When creating a JMS connection factory, queue, or topic, Sub Deployment Name is automatically populated with the resource name, even if no matching subdeployment exists. Changes can be committed, but destinations without a valid subdeployment target may not appear in JMS runtime monitoring.
  - Workaround: To avoid this issue, explicitly specify an existing, appropriately targeted subdeployment when subdeployment targeting is required.
- When changing a NoSQL or JDBC property from Value to Encrypted Value, clearing the Value text field leaves an empty string configured. Committing the change fails with an XML schema validation error because both values remain set.
  - Workaround: For Value, select Field Settings → Unset Value → OK, then enter the Encrypted Value, save, and commit the changes.
Dependency Changes
- Updated Node.js to 24.22.1
NOTE: Occasionally, WebLogic Remote Console may be affected by security vulnerabilities, either directly or indirectly through WebLogic Server. To maintain the security of your systems, you should install the latest Desktop WebLogic Remote Console, or if you are using Hosted WebLogic Remote Console, install the latest applicable Critical Patch Update (CPU) or Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU) for WebLogic Server. For more information and a list of products affected in the latest patch, see Oracle Critical Security Patch Update Advisory - November 2026.
